description: This file defines a mock implementation of the ChatService interface, used for offline testing and simulation of a chat agent's behavior without network connectivity.

classes.name: MockChatService
classes.description: A deterministic offline chat service used in testing; it simulates a simple two-step conversation flow to mimic agent interactions.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Handles sending messages within the mock chat service by returning predefined responses to simulate a conversation flow.
